new_claims.summary: Exact adaptive-tree identities retain crossing W, selector slack S and reflected-curvature remainder R through descendant recentering.
D_{A_i} >= [1+(1-2 eta)r_i]q_i for A_i={i} union F_i.
Across the adaptive robust-row compiler, sum pi_v[1+(1-2 eta)r_v]q_v <= J(root); at eta=1/16, sum pi_v r_vq_v <= 8J/7.
Selected robust-row binary entropy over all generations is <=C_eta J(root), with C_{1/16}=1.3494175371409616...<1.35.
Using the cited selector-debit theorem, selected robust-coordinate selector debit is <=2.8882922474225223... J(root) at eta=1/16; does not price all trigger-coordinate debits.
AND_n gives exact-subcube rows whose simultaneous fixed-state address sum is nJ; sequential physical removal avoids this reuse.
